contact_form_thank_you_body.name: contact_form_thank_you_body
contact_form_thank_you_body.default:
'We have received your message and a member of the TAVÚ team will get back to you as soon as possible.

Class and appointment bookings are handled through our online schedule, which is open at any time. For anything urgent, message us on WhatsApp at {phone}.'

newsletter_signup_text.name: newsletter_signup_text
newsletter_signup_text.default: 'New articles, studio news and upcoming events from TAVÚ, straight to your inbox.'

newsletter_consent_text.name: newsletter_consent_text
newsletter_consent_text.default: 'By subscribing you agree to receive emails from TAVÚ Wellness Studio. You can unsubscribe at any time.'

newsletter_success_text.name: newsletter_success_text
newsletter_success_text.default: 'Almost there. Please check your inbox and confirm your subscription.'

newsletter_confirm_body.name: newsletter_confirm_body
newsletter_confirm_body.default:
'Thank you for signing up to the TAVÚ newsletter. Please confirm that this is your email address by pressing the button below.

If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email and you will not be subscribed.'

newsletter_welcome_body.name: newsletter_welcome_body
newsletter_welcome_body.default:
'Your subscription is confirmed. You will now receive new articles, studio news and upcoming events from TAVÚ.

In the meantime, the journal is a good place to start.'

newsletter_confirmed_page_text.name: newsletter_confirmed_page_text
newsletter_confirmed_page_text.default: 'Thank you for confirming. The next TAVÚ newsletter will arrive in your inbox.'

newsletter_unsubscribed_page_text.name: newsletter_unsubscribed_page_text
newsletter_unsubscribed_page_text.default: 'You will no longer receive the TAVÚ newsletter. You can subscribe again at any time from our blog.'

newsletter_invalid_page_text.name: newsletter_invalid_page_text
newsletter_invalid_page_text.default: 'The link has expired or was already used. Please subscribe again from our blog.'
